Starhawk came out in 2012 for the PS3 only developed by LightBox Interactive, I got the game new on Amazon for $5.

Story for the game overall is ok, nothing real special. The gameplay is good, controls are pretty much spot on to what you do, both the shooting and melee are great. The game also has RTS elements in it which are ok, you pretty build defense systems and vehicles spawn ports, Starhawk could have benefited more with a deeper option of choices to build. Some sections of the game can get repetitive when you have to defend a point and just build base defenses in order to do so. My favorite thing about the game were the Hawks,it's goes from being a Mechwarrior to a star fighter with the press of a button, flight controls are good and dog fights are pretty fun. The sound does cut out in this game as well but only during the cut scenes so not as not as T-r-k

Mainly the bad things about this game are that the single player story is 5-6hrs long and the online multiplayer still works after all this time which surprised me, although the biggest game I played while on there was 3v3 when the max is 16v16, also if your online pass doesn't work it's $10 for it on PSN So overall for the price and amount of gameplay in it's current state 6/10.

For those of you who like the crappy game reviews better the next game I'm doing is Rogue Warrior which avg. a score of 2/10 from everybody.
